Name: HCW Alert Rule Reader
Description: Read alert rules (log, metric and Activity Log) and action groups in rg-web-site-prod-cus and rg-mgmt-plat-prod-cus, and nothing else. Consumed by infra/oidc.tf for verify-alert-state.yml (#1053): the weekly check that every declared alert rule is live, enabled and wired. Reader would also let it query every log in the Management workspace; this carries no data action and no other read. Created once by the owner because the Terraform identity deliberately lacks Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/write.
